heading: Arrest to be made strictly according to the Code.
text:
No arrest shall be made except in accordance with the provisions of this Code or any other law for the time being in force providing for arrest.]
A.—Summons
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
